You must answer on the enclosed answer booklet.
You will need: Answer booklet (enclosed)
Answer one question from your chosen Depth Study.
Follow the instructions on the front cover of the answer booklet. If you need additional answer paper,
ask the invigilator for a continuation booklet.
Answer one question from your chosen Depth Study.
DEPTH STUDY A: THE FIRST WORLD WAR, 1914–18
1 How important were new weapons as a cause of trench warfare on the Western Front? Explain
your answer. [40]
How significant was Germany’s two-front war as a reason for its defeat in 1918? Explain your
answer.
DEPTH STUDY B: GERMANY, 1918–45
How important were left-wing uprisings in Germany’s problems, 1919–23? Explain your answer.
How significant was the persecution of minorities as an aspect of Nazi policy, 1933–45? Explain
your answer. [40]
DEPTH STUDY C: RUSSIA, 1905–41
How important was Russia’s autocratic political system as a reason for the regime’s collapse by
March 1917? Explain your answer.
How significant were Stalin’s Purges in the creation of a totalitarian state in the Soviet Union after
1928? Explain your answer.
DEPTH STUDY D: THE UNITED STATES, 1919–41
How important was the movie industry in changing the lives of the American people in the 1920s?
Explain your answer. [40]
How significant was financial speculation as a cause of the Wall Street Crash in 1929? Explain
your answer. [40]
DEPTH STUDY E: CHINA, c.1930–c.1990
How important were health reforms in changing the lives of Chinese peasants by 1960? Explain
your answer.
How significant were economic reforms in changing the lives of the Chinese people in the period
1976–c.1990? Explain your answer.
DEPTH STUDY F: SOUTH AFRICA, c.1940–c.1994
How important were the policies of the United Party as a reason for the success of the National
Party in 1948? Explain your answer. [40]
How significant was the Rivonia Trial (1963–64) in preventing organised opposition to apartheid?
Explain your answer.
DEPTH STUDY G: ISRAELIS AND PALESTINIANS SINCE 1945
How important was British policy as a cause of tension in Palestine up to 1948? Explain your
answer. [40]
How significant were the Oslo Accords in dealing with the causes of tension between Israelis and
Palestinians? Explain your answer. [40]
